reviews.text: We found out about Arcanes through a family member. We had just adopted a puppy that looked like it was going to be big, and we wanted a sociable puppy. And indeed, Bruno, at 6 months old, weighs 30 kilos. He's a well-balanced puppy, sociable with ALL dogs. We also did urban obedience training—fabulous! We enjoy walks with our puppy, going out to the terraces... we truly recommend Arcanes 100%. Besides obedience, they offer theoretical classes to understand the psychology of our furry friends and the reasons behind their behaviors. We are very grateful for the personalized attention. Thank you, Virginia!

I learned about Arcanes through several friends who had had wonderful experiences. We arrived in the midst of chaos. My one-year-old greyhound was a bit of a terror, nipping at other dogs' rear ends and running off, bothering them. She barely obeyed any of my commands, was always very excited, and was reactive on the leash, barking at every dog ​​that passed by. I obviously didn't dare let her off the leash. Many days I cried from frustration, as this had never happened with my other dogs! I felt like we just didn't understand each other. And then she arrived, Virginia, with her joy, her patience, her positive reinforcement training. She taught me to set boundaries, helped me trust myself and my dog, and always believed that things would change for the better, and they did. We had individual classes, I took tons of notes that are still useful and that I continue to review, we did practical exercises, and we socialized with many other fantastic dogs at the school.

Virginia helped my dog, but she helped me the most—to observe, to listen, to be consistent, patient, and above all, to enjoy the unbeatable company of my best friend, my dog ​​Gaviota. Everyone should have a Virginia in their lives. Thank you ♥️

I loved the puppy course with Virginia! My 3-month-old puppy, Leo, and I both learned so much! 😄 He learned to stay calm at home without making a mess, to do his business outside, and to get along very well with other dogs and people (his social skills have improved). I 100% recommend this course; he has a great time, it's super dynamic, and Virginia is very attentive and pays attention to every detail.

We adopted a 7-year-old Weimaraner, whose separation anxiety was already ingrained in his genes. From day one, he showed he didn't want to be alone for even five minutes. He started howling, barking, and whining desperately—a real problem. So we contacted Arcanes because we already knew Virginia, who had rehabilitated our previous dog for other issues, and we had complete confidence in her. From the beginning, we started working with our dog through theoretical and practical classes, always with constant follow-up from Virginia, who sent us videos and gave us very useful advice. After a few months, he's a completely different dog; he stays alone without any problems. So I have nothing but praise for this professional, Virginia, who loves her work, and it shows in the love she gives our furry friends and how caring and understanding she is with us.

Virginia works wonders with animals and humans. We took Galleta to her puppy course and we couldn't be happier with her help, dedication, and professionalism. If you're thinking about taking a course, activity, or service with her, don't hesitate—I assure you it will be worth it. Thank you, Virginia ♥️

We went to puppy school with our 3-month-old dachshund. At first, we were hesitant about taking the course because we'd both had dogs in Argentina before.

But honestly, from the very first class, we left feeling motivated and with tons of new tools to better understand our puppy.

The training tips are taught with a super loving approach to the dog, not the "old school" authoritarian style. Understanding what your dog needs and getting parenting tips to truly enjoy having them is what we needed most, and thanks to this course, we took that knowledge home with us.

Virginia was always willing to answer our questions and help us every step of the way.

We recommend it whenever we can. 👐

This is the ideal place to get to know and train your dog better. Virginia has a great passion for her work and for animals, which she conveys in every class. If you need your dog to improve its obedience, pull less on the leash, socialize better with other dogs, respond more when called, stay, sit, lie down... don't hesitate to attend these classes. You'll also learn to connect better with your dog and even improve the games you play together. Thank you, Virginia, for the classes; they helped us a lot with Max.

We took the puppy training course at Arcanes with Virginia, and it was a fantastic experience. The course not only taught us how to properly train our puppy, but it was also crucial for his socialization.

We learned so much, and without this course, we probably would have made many mistakes that we now know how to avoid. The combination of theory, practice, and Virginia's caring approach makes everything very easy to apply and very enjoyable for both owners and puppies.

We recommend Arcanes to anyone who wants to give their puppy a happy and balanced start in life.

Our little dog Browny thought life itself was a threat. Thanks to Virginia's classes, he was gradually taught that being a dog can be a wonderful life full of canine friends.

Browny used to react to everything, but now, with Virginia's help, walks are much more enjoyable. Highly recommended!

Circumstances happen that are out of our control and so it was that we took possession of a 3-month-old Biewer Terrier when we were not able to spend much time working with him. Five months later – while we loved his spicy personality – we were realizing that Dali was beyond our control. He was not yet housebroken and was running us ragged. He also had some anxieties that were painful to see in a cherished companion.
That’s why I contacted Arcanes.

At our first meeting with Virginia, we were enchanted with her easy mannerisms and the uplifting lilt of her voice. Although her first language is Spanish, she speaks English very well. She spent time asking questions and chatting with us while Dali ran around like a maniac, playing with every toy he could find. Then, while still talking with us, she drew him in and spoke soothingly to calm him down a bit. She gave him puzzles with treats hidden inside and started giving us her evaluation of what she saw happening between us and the dog. She then took time to tell us the goals she would have for us if we wanted to work with her and said she would draw up a detailed plan and send it to us later that week. We left Arcanes that day feeling as if we had lucked out and found the right trainer to work with us.

I am not going to lie and tell you it was easy and now we have the perfect dog. We worked very hard both in and outside of the classes. Virginia was always pleasant and encouraging, and was very helpful when we sent her questions between classes. At this point, I can say that Dali is a much better companion who is on the path to being practically perfect in every way.

Dali has since graduated from the Puppy classes and meets with Virginia’s husband Nelo a few times a week for social time running around with other dogs. After the holidays, we will hopefully be in additional classes with Virginia and will continue to avail ourselves of the varied resources offered by this amazing and loving couple. We are part of the Arcanes family now.

A very positive experience for myself and my Border Collie puppy. Virginia is an excellent trainer and has helped my confidence grow in being a dog parent for the first time !  Along with the training she offered guideance specifically aimed at some of the problems I've been having with my BC. They are very intelligent dogs but that doesnt mean they are necessarily easy to train ! However, attending this course has allowed a safe space for both myself and my dog to learn together along with meeting and learning from other dogs and their owners. As a consequence I feel this has helped us to bond more closely.
And finally and importantly, it's been great fun ! A very big thank you to Virginia and the Arcanes community.

Virginia has been a great help in understanding our puppy Café's needs, and thanks to her, our communication with him has improved significantly. She's a fantastic professional and very easy to learn from. The puppy course is highly recommended!

Arcanes has been a key step in training our dog Yuca and in gaining a deeper understanding of canine psychology, which has also greatly helped us to understand our two furry family members.
The results have even been noticed by people outside our immediate family, and now we have the tools to give them a better quality of life. Virginia and Nelo are incredibly friendly, and without a doubt, one of the best experiences we've had is becoming part of their community. We will continue to recommend Arcanes.

I couldn't be happier that I took my puppy to the puppy course offered by Virginia and Nelo. I took her because I knew that Shiba Inus are a breed that tends to be disobedient, escape artists, and independent, and I wanted to understand her better and create a strong and lasting bond with my dog. Virginia and Nelo have undoubtedly helped us achieve that goal and many more. Freya has become a sociable, obedient dog and a wonderful companion. I highly recommend it to anyone who has a dog!

Awful.

Once again, I'm absolutely disappointed with the professionalism in the field of dog psychology and training. It's a real shame that this profession isn't regulated and practically anyone can practice it.

I went to them this summer (this is being published late due to Google's policy) and explained my situation. Briefly, I have a German Shepherd with reactivity towards other dogs, a problem that has been addressed for years by various "professionals." The dog has improved significantly thanks to my dedication and effort, but we wanted to take his socialization further in controlled environments with neutral dogs, since he still doesn't interact well with SOME dogs.

The first thing they did was schedule an appointment at a dog park to "test" my dog's behavior with other dogs (they changed the appointment several times). Initially, I didn't like this because it's a public place with owners and unfamiliar dogs whose personalities might not be compatible and could cause problems, but as always, you trust the positive reviews.

The trainer in question arrived HALF AN HOUR LATE, with only one dog, as it turned out the other trainer who was supposed to come with the rest of the dogs got lost and went to a different dog park (no comment).

He went into the dog park with his dog, a dog that, by the way, didn't respond to any commands—not "come here," not "leave it," absolutely nothing. He also spent the whole time chewing on the leash the trainer was holding, refusing to listen to "drop it." A very agitated dog, not ideal for my dog, and one that made his owner look bad. I stayed outside with my dog, circling the dog park, and my dog ​​got nervous because the other dogs (whose owners were unknown to me) were barking at the fence.

During this time, he spent more time telling me about his life than asking about my dog ​​or giving me any advice. He said he was divorced, that he had a new job and hadn't slept well, that he hadn't been able to take the dog out and that's why he was so nervous. I'm not even going to comment on what I think of this.

He suggested I bring my dog ​​in. At first, I said no because I thought it was dangerous to have my dog ​​on a leash and muzzled while the rest (all but one stranger) were off-leash. But after his insistence, I agreed. Luckily, nothing happened because the other dogs, including his, were just wandering around, ignoring everything, and didn't interact with my dog, who was just sniffing around.

We spent a good half hour wasting time while he chatted about how much he liked Cesar Millan (completely outdated in dog training and psychology) and gave me "advice" from a dog trainer, like, "Just let him be, he's very spoiled, and you'll see how he becomes the king of the dog park." That's for a 40kg German Shepherd who's reactive towards some dogs.

The best part was when his dog did his business and he had to ask ME for a bag because he didn't have one. Far from throwing it away, he left it in the middle of the park...

Finally, a dachshund came in with its owner. The dog had already been barking from outside, and I told him to be careful with my dog, to pick him up. He said not to worry, that nothing would happen. I insisted, and he took him by the leash that was hanging off him. And thank goodness, because the other dog tried to bite him, mine retaliated, and he couldn't control him. He almost fell and only managed to stop him by jerking the leash. Shameful, especially with a dog that has been trained in obedience and can be controlled with commands and distance without any need for aggression.

After that, he decided it was time to leave (he seemed overwhelmed and tired). He said goodbye to me, saying they would send me a WhatsApp message.

And that's how they work and TEST dogs with other dogs; that's how they give you a DIAGNOSIS—zero guidelines to follow, zero information about classes, prices, or anything else.

I expressed my dissatisfaction, they apologized, and that's it.

Excellent experience!

We are so grateful to Virginia and Nelo for everything we learned in the puppy course. Thanks to their guidance and professionalism, our relationship with Milo improved tremendously, leading to a greater understanding and redirection of his behavior, as well as improved communication. We noticed progress in his behavior, socialization, and confidence that we surely wouldn't have achieved without this course, and thanks to it, our life with him is much more harmonious. Furthermore, after the course, we became part of a community, which makes us feel supported, and we continue to learn every day. Thank you so much, Arcanes!

Not at all satisfied, they charged me over 1000 euros to help my dog, but they didn't do it. I paid the money, they had them for several months, and when they saw that they couldn't help him, they stopped writing to us and blocked us on WhatsApp.

Tor and I recently finished the Arcanes puppy course. After considering many options, we chose Arcanes, and it was a fantastic experience for both of us.
Tor has shown remarkable improvement, especially in his barking and socialization with other dogs. The vet told us at our last visit that Tor was noticeably calmer.
I especially enjoyed the recall class. Fantastic!
As an example of their professionalism and expertise, I'd like to mention that while the classes are supposed to be 90 minutes long, they always ran longer, and the instructor wouldn't finish until all the points for the day were explained.
In short, I highly recommend them for both puppies and their owners, as they provide the knowledge needed to continue working with our furry friends.

Virginia offered us a completely personalized plan based on the specific needs we wanted to improve and correct in our pet. Our relationship with our dog improved significantly as we began to understand the reasons behind her behaviors and how to address them. We learned not only tricks but also proper socialization for puppies, how to correct her bad habits, and how to establish healthy daily routines. Thanks to Virginia's guidance and by following her guidelines, our dog began to feel much more confident and free in the outside world, and she has even taken risks on her own thanks to the courage she gained during the course.

Before Virginia and Arcanes, my life with my dog was like a nightmare. A veterinarian recommended us; it was the best decision I've made. My dog had separation anxiety and reactivity with people and birds. He was out of control and couldn't exactly focus when we went out. The lessons teach you a more in-depth study into dogs than you can learn from searching on Google. She taught me more games that help build obedience and control reactivity. I received more help and advice than I expected. I can leave my dog alone for long periods of time; he knows how to calm down and control himself, and most of all, I think I've learned a good deal about how to handle my puppy when the situation seems to escalate. I sincerely recommend this school to anyone. I'm genuinely grateful to be part of this community now.

Thank you for everything, Virginia. You are a wonderful teacher, passionate about your work, and a truly sensitive person. We came to Arcanes when we considered ourselves dog lovers, and with you, we have learned to appreciate the affection …

This is my second time visiting Arcanes with my second dog, Milo. With our first dog, Cooper, they helped us immensely to understand the importance of training and communication with our dogs. With Milo, a super hyperactive Border Collie …

What led us to contact Virginia was that, after adopting a 4-month-old puppy who was a bit of a whirlwind, we wanted to do things right from the start this time. Now, at 7 months old, we can say it was completely worth it. …

We took our Spanish Water Dog to Virginia to help her become more independent and improve her energy levels and reduce her dependence on us. Thanks to Virginia's support and guidance, we now have methods and tools that allow our puppy to …

We've finished the puppy course with our dog Otto and we're very happy with the experience and what we learned.
Virginia taught us to better understand our puppy, how to train him to obey, how …
A great experience working with the Arcanes team. It was a valuable learning experience. …

I wholeheartedly recommend the puppy school. Virginia has taught us to understand our dog and meet his needs, greatly improving the harmony and quality of life for everyone at home: dog, cats, and humans. A fantastic choice.
Virginia and her team are wonderful. The dogs are super happy to go to the activities, and the families learn a lot.
